payload.words: A rethink page explains the problem before it lists where the concept breaks

lines.text: A rethink page has a section before the breaks that states what the concept is for and introduces each project word the page uses, each sentence a Fact item with a source
The page's data file can hold a diagram of the event that is not the shared party canvas, such as a commit graph, and the shipped script draws it
Section 1 holds an impact item: who meets the problem on the normal path, with the findings that show it

why: Dogfood of hyp-rethinking on F-1T5B7B, 2026-11-28 (page own-change): the owner said the page does not explain the problem comprehensively enough. The data file holds only id, title, concept, items, parties and approaches, each item one sentence, and the only diagram is the party canvas, so the page could not say what Own path is for, introduce H0 or the own change, draw the two branch shapes that give two verdicts, or name F-1NG9VB, which puts the defect on the normal path. Both checkers exited 0. Part of #468.
